+package game
+
+import "testing"
+
+// TestFactoryNGSacrificeUnlessDiscard covers ticket
+// engine.auto-sacrifice-unless-discard-3e88a33648 (Masticore class):
+// "sacrifice ~ unless you discard a card" must give the affected player a
+// real choice at resolution — discard a card to keep the source, or decline
+// and have it sacrificed — instead of an unconditional sacrifice.
+func TestFactoryNGSacrificeUnlessDiscard(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("declines discard: source is sacrificed", func(t *testing.T) {
+		gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+		src := NewCreature("Factory NG Masticore", ManaCost{}, 4, 4, 1)
+		src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
+		gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)
+
+		stackObj := &StackObject{
+			IsAbility:   true,
+			Text:        "sacrifice_unless_discard",
+			Controller:  0,
+			Card:        src,
+			EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{},
+		}
+		if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
+		}
+		if gs.PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("expected a pending sacrifice-unless-discard choice")
+		}
+
+		if err := gs.ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard(0, ""); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard: %v", err)
+		}
+		if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(src.ID); err == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("source was not sacrificed after declining the discard")
+		}
+	})
+
+	t.Run("discards a card: source survives", func(t *testing.T) {
+		gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+		src := NewCreature("Factory NG Masticore", ManaCost{}, 4, 4, 1)
+		src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
+		gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)
+
+		handCard := NewCreature("Factory NG Filler Card", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 1)
+		handCard.Owner, handCard.Controller = 0, 0
+		gs.Players[0].Hand.AddCard(handCard)
+
+		stackObj := &StackObject{
+			IsAbility:   true,
+			Text:        "sacrifice_unless_discard",
+			Controller:  0,
+			Card:        src,
+			EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{},
+		}
+		if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
+		}
+
+		if err := gs.ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard(0, handCard.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard: %v", err)
+		}
+		if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(src.ID); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("source was sacrificed despite discarding a card")
+		}
+		if gs.Players[0].Hand.HasCard(handCard.ID) {
+			t.Fatalf("discarded card is still in hand")
+		}
+	})
+
+	t.Run("unconditional filter-scoped sacrifice offers no discard option", func(t *testing.T) {
+		gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+		src := NewCreature("Factory NG Filter Sac Source", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
+		src.Owner, src.Controller = 0, 0
+		gs.Battlefield.AddCard(src)
+
+		stackObj := &StackObject{
+			IsAbility:   true,
+			Text:        "sacrifice",
+			Controller:  0,
+			Card:        src,
+			EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{},
+		}
+		_ = gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj)
+		if gs.PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("unconditional filter-scoped sacrifice must not offer a discard-to-avoid choice")
+		}
+	})
+}

+// PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard records a paused "sacrifice ~ unless you
+// discard a card" resolution ([VOCAB] sacrifice_unless_discard, ticket
+// engine.auto-sacrifice-unless-discard-3e88a33648, Masticore class): the
+// affected player may discard a card to keep Source, or decline and have
+// Source sacrificed instead. Kept as its own field rather than routed
+// through the generic PendingChoice/ResolvePendingChoice switch
+// (gamestate_choice.go): that switch's only "declined choice triggers an
+// alternate action" case is CounterSpellID (spell-specific) — there is no
+// existing hook for "declining a discard sacrifices a permanent instead" —
+// so ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard below completes either branch directly.
+type PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard struct {
+	PlayerIdx int
+	SourceID  string
+}
+
+// executeSacrificeUnlessDiscard implements the sacrifice_unless_discard
+// primitive: instead of sacrificing Source immediately (the unconditional
+// "sacrifice" case's behavior), it pauses on a PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard
+// so ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard can let the controller discard a card
+// instead once they choose to.
+func (gs *GameState) executeSacrificeUnlessDiscard(controller int, source *Card) error {
+	gs.PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard = &PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard{
+		PlayerIdx: controller,
+		SourceID:  source.ID,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard completes a pending sacrifice_unless_discard
+// choice (see PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard): discardCardID names a card in
+// the affected player's hand to discard, keeping Source alive; an empty
+// discardCardID declines the discard and sacrifices Source instead.
+func (gs *GameState) ResolveSacrificeUnlessDiscard(playerIdx int, discardCardID string) error {
+	pending := gs.PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard
+	if pending == nil || pending.PlayerIdx != playerIdx {
+		return nil
+	}
+	gs.PendingSacrificeUnlessDiscard = nil
+
+	if discardCardID != "" {
+		if player := gs.Players[playerIdx]; player.Hand.HasCard(discardCardID) {
+			return gs.Discard(playerIdx, discardCardID)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	if card, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(pending.SourceID); err == nil {
+		gs.sacrificeCard(card, playerIdx)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
